name: Chasing Tail
source:
Chasing Tail is a visual novel set in the fictitious city of Scalan, populated by animalistic creatures of all shapes and sizes. Within the story you'll interact with a number of unique characters each with their own story, issues, and feelings. Your actions and answers to questions will alter who you spend time with, and each characters affection towards you. This will also in turn affect dialogue options and the outcome of the story. At the end of the game maybe things will turn out great for you and someone else, or maybe not.

[From [url=https://storage.googleapis.com/www.scylez.com/Website%20Files/gaming.htm]Official site[/url]]
translation:
《追逐尾巴》是一部视觉小说，舞台设在虚构城市斯卡兰，那里生活着各种形态的兽类居民。故事中，你会与许多独特角色互动，了解他们各自的故事、烦恼与感受。你的行动与回答会改变你与谁共度时光，也会影响每个角色对你的好感，进而改变对话选项与故事结局。游戏结束时，你也许会和某个人迎来美好结局，也许不会。

[来源：[url=https://storage.googleapis.com/www.scylez.com/Website%20Files/gaming.htm]官方网站[/url]]
